messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-db-prod | symptom=pg connections > 95% | trigger=pg_max_conn_threshold
pagerduty: Page created: PD-INC-8721 — Escalation policy: eng-oncall. Paging dev oncall.
de vin: ack — I'm looking. seeing spike in active connections on pgbouncer stats.
marie: ack. I'm with you, pulling pg_stat_activity now.
alex: I see many idle+waiting clients from inference-api nodes trying to open new conns. suspect connection storms during warmup.
devin: quick snapshot: run on primary ->
```
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='idle') AS idle,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='active') AS active,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL) AS waiting
FROM pg_stat_activity;
```
marie: results: idle=120, active=430, waiting=78 (max_conn=1024) but pgbouncer max_client_conn=600 and pgbouncer pool_size=100 per app instance — hitting pool limits and queueing.
oncall-manager: customer impact: 5% error rate on gen requests, latency p95 > 2.5s for queued connections. No full outage but visible errors. Ticket created: IN-8423 for customers experiencing 502.
de vin: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase pgbouncer max_client_conn to 900, 2) bump pool_size to 150 for inference-api pool, 3) enable connection_lifetime short-circuit on warmup path, 4) add short-term rolling restart of a subset of inference-api pods to re-establish pools.
marie: I'm going to change pgbouncer config on primary staging first then prod. running sudo on bastion:
```bash
kubectl -n infra exec deployment/pgbouncer -- psql -c "SHOW POOLS;"
# then update configmap and rollout restart deployment/pgbouncer
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/pgbouncer MAX_CLIENT_CONN=900 && kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/pgbouncer
```
alex: I'll coordinate app-side restart. We should stagger 20% at a time to avoid thundering herd.
devin: Applying quick SQL to kill some long-idle client backends to free slots:
```sql
SELECT pid, usename, state, query_start, now() - query_start AS age
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state='idle' AND now() - query_start > interval '10 minutes';
-- then CANCEL/PG_TERMINATE_BACKEND for the worst offenders
```
oncall-manager: Devin/marie, update with timing so I can message CS to throttle feature flags if needed.
marie: pgbouncer updated and rolling. watching connection_count from cloudwatch.
(10m later)
marie: pgbouncer rollout finished. client_conn metric dropping to normal range. active waiting down to ~12.
devin: restarted 3/15 inference-api pods staggered. connection storm subsided. errors down to ~0.7%, p95 latency back to ~480ms.
alex: still seeing a small backlog on one AZ (az-east-2) — opening a targeted restart for that node.
oncall-manager: Notifying CS: "We mitigated a connection storm affecting inference generation; customers may have seen brief 5-10m errors/warnings. No data loss. We are following up with a permanent fix."
marie: root cause hypothesis: recent autoscaler warmup caused many app replicas to concurrently try to open new DB connections; pgbouncer pools were undersized for bursty warmup.
devin: next steps: 1) add startup jitter to app so they don't open at once, 2) increase pgbouncer pool_size for inference-api permanently to 150, 3) add synthetic warmup that pre-populates pools, 4) add alert to detect pgbouncer queue length > 100 before DB connection % crosses threshold.
oncall-manager: assign follow-up to oncall post-incident: marie/devin for config changes, alex for app jitter rollout.
marie: handing off to next oncall in 30m. I'll leave runbook updates in #runbooks and link this thread.
alex: ack. I'll create the PR for startup jitter and link to IN-8423.
pagerduty: Incident PD-INC-8721 acknowledged by devin, status: resolved (monitoring).
incident-bot: Thread closed by oncall-manager — follow-up tasks created.
